notes.text: יוסטינה and יוסטא are retained as Yustina and Yusta. The abbreviated titles remain R'; the pointer adds no biographical relationship.
The source heading was recorded as provisional; an earlier audit read יוסמינה. This does not establish a printed variant or settle the reading.
